Stardew Valley obv I don't give a damn about the pixelation (though I'll note that the graphics aren't pure pixel, there are other visual flourishes), but if I'm playing, say, MS Flight Sim? Yeah, I want those shinies for immersion and experience.

normal.name: Artisan Dragon
normal.text: You know what worries me about GTA6 now existing? Is that every other AAA game is going to see: Oh! Gamers love having life-sim elements in their games, let's add that. And now Ubisoft games are going to make me "workout" just so I can lug a rocket launcher to destroy the next outpost. >_>
